chars.WIFE: BROTHER'S WIFE: a young Moroccan woman in her late twenties, long wavy dark brown hair worn loose, wearing a pink satin pajama set with white piping
chars.ME: NARRATOR: a young Moroccan man in his mid twenties, short black hair, light stubble, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and black joggers

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, inside a modest Moroccan family apartment. Seen from the far end of a dim hallway: the brother's wife leans out of her half-open bedroom door, one hand on the door frame, calling softly down the hallway with a sly smile, warm lamp light behind her. Head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night, a small Moroccan bedroom with a single bed and a zellige-pattern blanket. The narrator, just about to sit on his bed, freezes and turns his head toward the open door with wide surprised eyes, hearing someone call him. Head-to-waist framing.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Night, a narrow Moroccan apartment hallway with patterned tiles. The narrator walks toward a half-open bedroom door at the end, hands in his hoodie pocket, trying to look casual and normal but visibly nervous. Seen from behind at a three-quarter angle so his face is partly visible.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Night, at the doorway of a Moroccan bedroom lit by a warm lamp. The brother's wife leans on the door frame giving the narrator a long sly flirty look with a raised eyebrow; the narrator stands frozen in front of her, stiff and embarrassed, not knowing what to say. Both faces visible, side view.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Night, Moroccan bedroom doorway, warm lamp light. The brother's wife laughs coyly while twirling a lock of her hair with her finger; the narrator forces an awkward fake smile, sweating, leaning slightly away. Comic awkward mood. Both faces visible.
